capabilities: Renders Markdown tables in Live Preview for fast scrolling and typing
Selects cells and ranges with keyboard or mouse
Edits, formats, cuts, copies and pastes cells and ranges
Adds, moves, sorts and deletes rows, columns and cells
Freezes rows and columns via header comments or settings
extras: Freeze state is stored as an invisible %%freeze rows cols%% comment in the header row; tables are drawn only in Live Preview (not Source mode, Reading view, canvas cards or hover previews), frozen pinning is not yet available on phones and tablets, and the plugin was built with Claude Code.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes Markdown tables in Live Preview faster and easier to navigate.
motivation: The author wanted scrolling notes with large tables to be seamless, without flickering, stuttering, or a table changing size as Obsidian reveals the Markdown for every cell the caret passes.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview tables stutter, flicker and resize when scrolling large notes, and moving between cells opens an editor each time.
summary: Re-renders Markdown tables in Live Preview for smooth scrolling, keyboard cell navigation, range selection, in-place editing and frozen rows and columns.
